lever_full: Tripartite social dialogue and wage bargaining
joins_when: it organises dialogue among government, employers and workers
joins_not: it is business dialogue (L3-257)
pathways: L3-258 Social dialogue and wage bargaining
evidence: Social dialogue and wage bargaining: Calmfors and Driffill 1988
intervention_evidence: Aidt and Tzannatos 2002, Unions and Collective Bargaining: Economic Effects in a Global Environment, World Bank | OECD 2019, Negotiating Our Way Up: Collective Bargaining in a Changing World of Work, OECD
evidence_finding: Coordinated bargaining tends to lower wage inequality and supports employment adjustment, but effects on growth vary with coordination level and whether agreements allow firm flexibility.

lever: Community scorecards and monitoring of providers
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Community scorecards and monitoring of providers
joins_when: it has communities monitor service providers
joins_not: it has them decide (L3-247) or manage funds (L3-248)
pathways: L3-246 Community monitoring of providers
evidence: Community monitoring of providers: Bjorkman and Svensson 2009
intervention_evidence: Waddington et al. 2019, Citizen Engagement in Public Services in Low- and Middle-Income Countries: A Mixed-Methods Systematic Review of Participation, Inclusion, Transparency and Accountability Initiatives, Campbell Systematic Reviews
evidence_finding: Community monitoring improves service access and some outcomes on average, but effects are small and vary, and work best when combined with provider incentives and responsive authorities.
entry_points: ["Environmental Monitoring Participation Empowerment"]

lever: Community-driven development and community enterprise funds
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Community-driven development and community enterprise funds
joins_when: it gives communities control of funds or projects, including community enterprises
joins_not: it is participation in planning only (L3-247)
pathways: L3-248 Community-driven development and social capital
evidence: Community-driven development and social capital: Casey, Glennerster and Miguel 2012; Casey 2018
intervention_evidence: White, Menon and Waddington 2018, Community-Driven Development: Does It Build Social Cohesion or Infrastructure? A Mixed-Method Evidence Synthesis, 3ie Working Paper 30
evidence_finding: Community-driven development reliably builds local infrastructure but has no measurable effect on social cohesion or governance, and elite capture persists where facilitation is weak.
entry_points: ["Community-based tourism and secondary city tourism support programme", "Community-Based Tourism and Secondary Cities Tourism Support", "Community Tourism Enterprise Incubation and Financing Network", "Community Social Welfare and Services Provision", "Strengthening local community participation in public-interest and social organization"]

lever: Support for civil society and volunteer networks
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Support for civil society and volunteer networks
joins_when: it strengthens civil society organisations or volunteer networks as watchdogs
joins_not: it is community management of funds (L3-248)
pathways: L3-249 Civil society density and accountability
evidence: Civil society density and accountability: Putnam 1993
intervention_evidence: Gugerty and Kremer 2008, Outside Funding and the Dynamics of Participation in Community Associations, American Journal of Political Science
evidence_finding: External funding to Kenyan women's groups did not strengthen them; it drew in younger, better-educated and male members who displaced the poorest, showing support can crowd out grassroots voice.
entry_points: ["Volunteering Networks for Corruption Surveillance", "Civil Society Oversight of Public Agencies and Officials"]

lever: Reducing polarisation between groups and parties
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Measures that lower the stakes of group contest; Measures against partisan animosity and media segregation
joins_when: it names polarisation between social groups or political sides and acts to lower it
joins_not: it is identity-building (L3-014) or contact (L3-013) (L3-012); it is group grievance (L3-011) (L3-017)
pathways: L3-012 Polarisation and conflict intensity; L3-017 Affective polarisation and partisan animosity
evidence: Polarisation and conflict intensity: Esteban and Ray 1994; Esteban, Mayoral and Ray 2012; Affective polarisation and partisan animosity: Iyengar et al. 2019
intervention_evidence: Voelkel et al. 2024, Megastudy Testing 25 Treatments to Reduce Antidemocratic Attitudes and Partisan Animosity, Science
evidence_finding: Many short interventions reduced partisan animosity, but most did not reduce antidemocratic attitudes and effects faded within weeks, so lasting depolarisation needs sustained exposure.

lever: National identity, shared values, culture and civic education
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: National identity, shared values, culture and civic education
joins_when: it builds shared identity, values or culture
joins_not: it is intergroup contact (L3-013)
pathways: L3-014 Nation-building and shared identity
evidence: Nation-building and shared identity: Miguel 2004; Alesina, Giuliano and Reich 2021
intervention_evidence: Cantoni, Chen, Yang, Yuchtman and Zhang 2017, Curriculum and Ideology, Journal of Political Economy | Bazzi, Gaduh, Rothenberg and Wong 2019, Unity in Diversity? How Intergroup Contact Can Foster Nation Building, American Economic Review
evidence_finding: A new Chinese school curriculum shifted students' political views, and mixed resettlement in Indonesia fostered national identity, but only where no single group dominated locally.
entry_points: ["Promote national pride and cultural heterogeneity", "Reinforce Social Institutions through Values and Thai Culture", "Promote positive cultural and family values", "Community Identity and Learning Strengthening Initiative", "Cultural Pride, Unity, and ASEAN Cultural Networks"]

lever: Reconciliation, peace processes and transitional justice
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Reconciliation, peace processes and transitional justice
joins_when: it deals with past conflict or builds peace
joins_not: it is crime (F-08)
pathways: L3-015 Transitional justice and reconciliation
evidence: Transitional justice and reconciliation: Cilliers, Dube and Siddiqi 2016
intervention_evidence: Olsen, Payne and Reiter 2010, Transitional Justice in Balance: Comparing Processes, Weighing Efficacy, United States Institute of Peace Press | Hartzell and Hoddie 2003, Institutionalizing Peace: Power Sharing and Post-Civil War Conflict Management, American Journal of Political Science
evidence_finding: Trials combined with amnesties improve human rights and democracy more than truth commissions alone, and peace settlements with several power-sharing provisions are more durable.
entry_points: ["Peaceful Conflict Management Learning Programme", "Study and promote peaceful conflict management approaches"]

lever: Jobs and income for potential combatants
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Jobs and income for potential combatants
joins_when: it offers livelihoods to people at risk of joining violence
joins_not: it is general employment (F-34)
pathways: L3-016 Opportunity cost of violence
evidence: Opportunity cost of violence: Collier and Hoeffler 2004; Blattman and Miguel 2010
intervention_evidence: Blattman and Annan 2016, Can Employment Reduce Lawlessness and Rebellion? A Field Experiment with High-Risk Men in a Fragile State, American Political Science Review | Blattman and Ralston 2015, Generating Employment in Poor and Fragile States: Evidence from Labor Market and Entrepreneurship Programs, SSRN Working Paper
evidence_finding: Agricultural training and capital for Liberian ex-fighters reduced illicit work and interest in mercenary recruitment, mainly through expected future cash; training alone rarely raises incomes.

lever: Visible service delivery and economic security to restore trust
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Visible service delivery and economic security to restore trust
joins_when: it names restoring trust in institutions as the aim
joins_not: it is a service expansion with no trust aim stated (its own family)
pathways: L3-259 Insecurity-driven erosion of institutional trust
evidence: Insecurity-driven erosion of institutional trust: Algan et al. 2017; Guriev and Papaioannou 2022
intervention_evidence: Berman, Shapiro and Felter 2011, Can Hearts and Minds Be Bought? The Economics of Counterinsurgency in Iraq, Journal of Political Economy | Crost, Felter and Johnston 2014, Aid Under Fire: Development Projects and Civil Conflict, American Economic Review
evidence_finding: Small, responsive service projects reduced violence in Iraq where security was present, but a large Philippine community programme increased insurgent attacks as rebels sought to sabotage it.

lever: Structured contact and cooperation across groups
subpillar: Reform Leadership, Coalitions and Civic Engagement
lever_full: Structured contact and cooperation across groups
joins_when: it brings groups together in cooperation or shared activity
joins_not: it is national identity (L3-014)
pathways: L3-013 Intergroup contact and prejudice reduction
evidence: Intergroup contact and prejudice reduction: Allport 1954; Mousa 2020; Lowe 2021
intervention_evidence: Paluck, Green and Green 2019, The Contact Hypothesis Re-evaluated, Behavioural Public Policy | Scacco and Warren 2018, Can Social Contact Reduce Prejudice and Discrimination? Evidence from a Field Experiment in Nigeria, American Political Science Review
evidence_finding: Contact reduces prejudice on average, but effects are weaker for ethnic and racial divides; in Nigeria mixed classes reduced discrimination in behaviour without changing stated prejudice.
entry_points: ["Community and Cultural Relationship-Building Networks"]
